summary: Frontend testing of 'Why Be a Founder' marketing page. All requested features verified successfully. Page loads at /why-founder, navigation link exists in PublicNav, hero section with badge and CTAs renders correctly, all major sections (Real Problem, What Makes Different, Operations Core, Portal System, AI Design Lab, Final CTA) are present, and footer renders at bottom.

integration_issues.flow: Apply for Founder Access button navigation
integration_issues.issue: Links to /register but no /register route exists in App.js - redirects to /login instead. Login page has registration toggle, so users can still register via 'Don't have an account? Create one' link.

nav_link.description: 'Why Be a Founder' link present in PublicNav (desktop and mobile)

hero_section.description: Hero with headline 'Turn Your Sign Shop Into an Intelligent System', Founder Access badge, and CTA buttons renders correctly

apply_button.description: 'Apply for Founder Access' button links to /register but redirects to /login (no /register route defined)

pricing_button.description: 'See Founder Pricing' button correctly navigates to /pricing page

major_sections.description: All sections verified: The Real Problem, What Makes Different (Intelligent Workforce Tracking, Intelligent Pricing), Operations & Productivity Core, Complete Portal System, Advanced AI Design Lab, AI Business Brain, Production Intelligence, Why Founder Access Matters, Final CTA

footer.description: PublicFooter renders at bottom with copyright © 2026 SignGuy AI

mobile_responsive.description: Mobile menu shows 'Why Be a Founder' navigation link correctly

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add /register route in App.js to redirect to /login with registration mode, or update all /register links to /login. Current behavior is functional but not ideal UX.
critical_code_review_comments: WhyFounderPage.js links to /register but App.js has no /register route - falls through to protected routes catch-all which redirects to /login
Similar links to /register exist in other pages (LandingPage, FeaturesPage, AboutPage, PublicNav, FoundersEditionPricing)

success_rate.frontend: 95% - All visual and functional tests pass, minor routing issue with /register

context_for_next_testing_agent: Why Be a Founder page at /why-founder is fully functional marketing page. Note: /register links redirect to /login where users can toggle to registration mode. All page sections render correctly including hero, dashboard preview, problem section, features sections, portal system, AI design lab, and footer.
